messages:
maria: Hey team — FinSight (customer) requested a bespoke instruct variant + long-context scoring (64k) on-prem. Wants a quantized build for lower latency. High priority. Kickoff: what are the main blockers and owners?

jonah: Got it. Do we have a preferred model family? they mentioned Llama2-70b instruct but also asked if an instruction-tuned finetune would be better. @kevin, bandwidth for quant experiments this week?

kevin: I can take lead on quant. Suggest starting from base 70b -> instruct tuning pipeline so we can compare: 1) base + prompting, 2) instruct-tuned. Quant approach: q4_8 with per-channel scaling + act-order. Expect ~1.7-2x speedup vs fp16 but watch for numeric/regression. I'll run an initial smoke run.

eva: Ops notes: on-prem / private control plane means HSM + no internet access. Also need to validate KV cache persistence for continuous longctx sessions. Storage and memory SLOs must be documented.

maria: Proposed onboarding checklist:
1) model selection + license review
2) collect & vet instruct dataset (customer-supplied + reg set)
3) quant experiments + calibration tests
4) long-context kernel validation (64k)
5) perf & latency benchmarks (p50/p95/p99)
6) quality regression gates & eval suite
7) rollout plan (canary -> full)
I'll add this to the onboarding tracker.

jonah: Added a ticket #ONBOARD-1987. I'll spin up the eval harness: rouge/bertscore for summarization, exact-match for numeric extractions, and a hallucination detector. Which prompt bank to use?

maria: Uploading their 50 seed prompts here: https://files.redwood/fin/seed_prompts — permissions set to the team. Target metrics: >0.82 BERTScore on fin-summary test, entity recall >=98% (max hallucination 2%).

kevin: Quick smoke from my local run (q4_8, per-channel): throughput +1.9x, latency down ~40% p95. However numeric extraction on tiny ledger tasks dropped ~12% vs fp16. Need ablations: per-channel vs symmetric, q4_0 baseline, and check calibration.

jonah: If numeric extraction drops, we can implement post-processing for ledger fields (rule-based) while we tune. Also, we should benchmark instruct-tuned vs base+prompting to quantify uplift. Keep both variants in pipeline.

maria: Agreed. We'll maintain two pinned variants: fin-instruct-v1 and fin-base-longctx-v1. Rollout: canary on a dedicated pool for the customer, monitor cost + accuracy.

eva: Ops flag: enabling 64k requires the sparse attention kernel on runtime. Runbook note: set runtime flag --enable-sparse-longctx and confirm CUDA 12.2 artifacts are available on the infra image.

kevin: Experiment plan (short):
- Step A: fp16 baseline @32k
- Step B: fp16 @64k
- Step C: q4_8 @64k (per-channel)
- Step D: q4_0 @64k (throughput stress)
I'll push logs/metrics to s3://redwood-experiments/fin/1745021110/ and link results in the ticket.

maria: Who takes customer comms and compliance? Need DSA, SOC2 pointers, and license sign-off.

jonah: I'll own compliance & legal ping. Also preparing the eval notebooks.

maria: Kevin, include a quick config snippet in the ticket for reproducibility.

kevin: config snippet:
```
model: fin-instruct-v1
base_model: llama2-70b
quant: q4_8
long_context: 65536
kernels: sparse_attention=true
```

kevin: Note — if numeric regression >3% we should fallback to fp16 for production. Quality gate is strict for finance.

maria: Timeline proposal: kickoff today, quant experiments by EOW, eval results by next Wed, canary in 2 weeks. Owners: Jonah (eval/compliance), Kevin (quant/bench), Eva (ops), Maria (PM).

eva: I'll own rollout ops and the runtime validation. Will coordinate infra image with eng-runtime.

deploy-bot: created routing tag fin-prod-cust and reserved pool fin-64k-1 (2 GPUs) :white_check_mark:

maria: Perfect — I'll update #ONBOARD-1987 with tasks, owners, and deadlines. TL;DR: Customer requested instruct + longctx quantized private deploy; owners assigned, experiments planned, and tracker live. :thumbsup:

jonah: ack. Will start eval jobs and link baseline artifacts.

kevin: starting runs now — will report ablation results in the ticket.

maria: thanks everyone. I added a note to legal for licensing. Will follow up on kernel/CUDA imaging with eng-runtime.
